_metadata.description: Shared health-provider foundation: validation RPC, maturity ladder, metrics, target resolution, and provider-native detail.

requirements.title: Shared validation RPC emits provider-owned maturity
requirements.description: API Health implements scenario-validation/v1 ScenarioValidationService.ValidateScenario, returns canonical status, common.v1.MaturityAssessment, provider-native API Health detail, and real ExecutionMetrics.

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/handlers/validation/connect_handler_test.go. Assert assessment identity, metrics presence, status mapping, and native detail packing.

requirements.title: Capability ladder maps every finding
requirements.description: .vrooli/maturity.json declares API Health capabilities and maps every finding code to capability_id, local_level_impact, global_impact, dimension, clean_requirement, severity, and fixability metadata.

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/internal/validation/maturity_spec_test.go. Load and ValidateSpec; assert no emitted finding code is missing from the spec.

requirements.title: Target resolver reports coverage honestly
requirements.description: Target resolution distinguishes missing scenario, scenario with no API surface, unreadable source, and inspectable API surface without reporting a clean pass for an unevaluated target.

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/internal/validation/target_test.go. Fixtures for missing, no-api, unreadable, and inspectable targets.
